title: 5c brainstorm: convention system design
description:
Brainstorm the full convention system using vidhi-brainstorm. Key areas:

- Convention lifecycle enforcement — how descriptive/preferred/deprecated/forbidden states drive agent orientation and violation reporting. What triggers promotion/demotion?
- Per-component conventions — conventions scoped to components (from 5b), not just global. "Handlers in this component look like X" vs "all functions return Result"
- Structural templates — when FCA detects a convention, extract a concrete template with metavariables for agent orientation. Representation format, serving to agents.
- Effect tracking as FCA attributes — enriching the attribute matrix with side effects (filesystem, network, DB, mutable state). Rust gives async/unsafe hints. Transitive effect reachability.
- Convention drift detection — time-series tracking of convention cohesion. Alert when multi-agent development causes divergence within a component.
- Incremental FCA — checking changed symbols against existing implications without full recomputation
- How the current FCA engine + convention_overrides durable companion (from 5a) evolves into the full system
- Interaction with the trust model — confidence levels on conventions, waiver tracking for convention violations
- The module rename (fca/ → conventions/) — when and how

Input: docs/sutra-vision.md (L2 section), current FCA engine code, 5a decisions (adapter traits, storage partition, durable companion pattern)
Output: shared understanding ready for PRD
